summary: Frontend-only expansion retest completed with deterministic procedural regression checks and responsive UI/integration validation. Most UI/runtime requirements pass; two procedural balancing rules fail in world generation.

integration_issues.issue: Enemy proximity cap requirement (max 3 within 720px) is violated; generated worlds commonly contain 4 enemies within one 720px vertical window.
Shooter spacing occasionally drops below 260m (observed ~256.1m and ~256.8m), violating the stated minimum.

action_items: In world.js spawnEnemy, enforce global/grouped vertical density rule (not just local candidate check) so no >3 hostiles exist in any 720px band.
In world.js shooter spacing, compute/check spacing using final spawn elevation context (post-gap/platform elevation) to guarantee >=260m in actual spawned shooter heights.
After fix, rerun /app/tests/frontend_procedural_regression.mjs and verify zero failures on seeds 1..300 with /app/tests/procedural_diagnostics.mjs.
critical_code_review_comments: spawnEnemy currently checks nearby enemies against candidate platform y only; this allows overlapping windows where middle enemies can still see 4 within 720px.
Shooter lockout uses `height` sampled before top/gap update, while shooter entities are spawned relative to final platform y, creating spacing drift that can undershoot 260m in spawned results.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Deterministic seeds used in test scripts only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Passed checks: app loads, no runtime console/network failures, PNG requests successful (145 observed, 0 failed), no SVG DOM nodes, guide tab counts correct (platforms 9, powers 6, enemies 7, zones 5), rocket non-stack behavior and timer rules pass in deterministic test, power badges render (6), mobile portrait 390x844 and 320x568 no horizontal overflow, storage warning recovery true->false passes. Remaining blockers are procedural enemy density and shooter spacing minima.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: run `node /app/tests/frontend_procedural_regression.mjs` (fails consistently) and `node /app/tests/procedural_diagnostics.mjs` (300 seeds scanned). Results: enemy proximity violation appears in all 300/300 seeds (4 enemies within one 720px band), shooter spacing violation appears in 2/300 seeds (~256m). Root causes: (1) density check is local to spawn candidate and does not enforce a global 720px window cap across all enemies; (2) shooter spacing guard compares with `height` captured before platform gap/top update, while actual shooter spawn uses post-update platform position, causing occasional undershoot of intended 260m separation.
